ops.body: Round-2 implementation landed in the /tmp/fixwave/daemonkit clone as local commit f1f9061 (atop 4c45d84, rebased on origin/main 1f52003): waitUntilReady poll()==0 now throws systemCall(op, ETIMEDOUT) per the transport's own deadline convention; provesSessionTransition drops EAGAIN+ETIMEDOUT from the peer-end set; transport deadline expiry classifies as ServiceSocketClientError.deadlineExceeded and is no longer lifetime-terminal (an expired handshake had bricked the bridge's lifecycle client until restart); BrokerSocketBridge handoff failures duplicate to stderr (criterion 773cddb). swift test 180/180 green, task build/lint green. Not pushed, not tagged.
